svg.title: A cell frame, two kinds, one cell
svg.desc: Three columns of boxes. Tag 1, left, in teal: the general frame Cell with five empty slots: type, nominal_voltage, measured_voltage, inspection and location. Tag 2, middle, in teal: two more specific frames, LiIonCell with type = LI_ION and nominal_voltage = 3.6 V, and NiMHCell with type = NIMH and nominal_voltage = 1.2 V; a solid arrow goes from each to Cell. Tag 3, right, in magenta: the cell c1, with type = LI_ION, nominal_voltage = 3.6 V, measured_voltage = 3.55 V, inspection = passed and location = agv1, slot 1; a dashed arrow goes from c1 to LiIonCell.
